verdict.rationale: Fine-tuning is a fair question for a model and API vendor, so the axis applies. The pack documents inference, tools, Batch API, Collections (retrieval) and voice cloning, but none of these is a hosted fine-tuning API or downloadable open weights. Collections and custom voices are adjacent features, not training on the user's data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights
